At 850 AM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 16 nm southeast of Rockport to 8 nm northeast of Port
Aransas, moving east at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets.

Locations impacted include...
Port Aransas and Rockport.

events.region: Charleston Harbor; Coastal waters from South Santee River to Edisto Beach SC out 20 NM; Coastal waters from Edisto Beach SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWCHS

The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from South Santee River SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM...
Charleston Harbor...

* Until 1130 AM EDT.

* At 932 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Fripp Island Reef, moving northeast at
20 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Charleston Nearshore Reef, Joe Shuford Reef, Charleston Sixty, Air
Force Reef, Charleston Coastal Anglers, Rattlesnake Shoal, Capers
Reef, Charleston Harbor Entrance, Lowcountry Anglers, Capers Island
Buoy, Bull Breakers, Kiawah Reef, Bulls Bay, N. Edisto Nearshore
Reef and Jimmy Leland Tug.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Water levels as high as 1 to 3 feet above normal
highest tide line.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Sunday to 7 PM Monday.

* IMPACTS...There is potential for coastal erosion due to high
surf. Coastal flooding is possible during high tide.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Prolonged southerly winds of 30 to 40 mph

evening. The resulting higher seas and surf, coinciding with
high tide, will raise potential for rough surf and coastal
erosion. Additionally, prolonged rainfall is expected Sunday
afternoon through at least Tuesday.
